method.enabled: fresh Unix socket per request, shared daemon RPC, decoded JSON and canonical projection
method.disabled: fresh rg process per search/discovery; direct buffered Python read/hash for known ranges
method.cache: OS cache warm in both arms; no drop_caches, no CPU affinity; shared nonexclusive Linux host
method.order: seeded randomized task order and randomized paired mode order
method.warmup: one correctness-checked pass per session, excluded from timed samples
method.correctness: all timed pairs exactly equal: paths, full match counts, text, windows, SHA-256
method.ci: 5000 seeded paired cluster-bootstrap resamples of daemon-session means, percentile 95% intervals
method.privacy: No usernames, hostnames, local paths, hardware identifiers, or host configuration collected
method.limits: Retrieval microbenchmark only; not VS Code dispatch, model selection, tokens, agent task time, or disk-cold I/O
method.cold: one first-use miss + rg fallback per session; explicit sync measured separately; daemon startup excluded
